Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: The cube's back under lock and key, thanks to you. The station owes you one.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Any sign of my Maguffin Cube? Small, purple, hums like a bad capacitor. It's around here somewhere.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: A courier fumbled my Maguffin Cube somewhere on this deck and I can't leave my post. Would you track it down for me?

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Much obliged. It's a small purple cube with a hum you can feel in your teeth — you can't miss it.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Hmph. It won't walk back on its own.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: That hum — you found it! Hand it over, courier.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Then it walks off with you. I'm not testing that arm twice.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: That cube is station property, courier. Last chance — hand it over, or I take it.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Yes, that's the one. You have my thanks, courier.
